Theme: MCP. When a PDF read is cut before page 1, an external agent is told the text is partial, but no text came back. The agent acts on that sentence, so this is an effect, not just wording. It is a rare path, with no named customer and no data lost. In a theme without a direct effect, that is p2 (the suggested grade was p3).
